_comment: Participant registry (SSOT). UI/CLI/dispatcher read display/avatar/color/role/wake from here. Adding a model = one entry. 'wake' = how that participant is re-invoked when a message arrives for it: harness-reinvoke (Claude Code: watcher exits, harness re-calls), active-turn-poll (Codex: only during an active turn), spawn (headless one-shot, e.g. 'gemini -p'), none (human).
